programme.title: Vera T14 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O capítulo final e emocionante do drama policial com Brenda Blethyn no papel da Inspetora-chefe Vera Stanhope despede-se do público. Um estudante violentamente morto e largado ao pé de três monólitos míticos e uma rapariga desaparecida levam Vera a uma investigação que desperta memórias da sua própria infância. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer T6 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: A investigação da rixa de sangue albanesa revela um segredo surpreendente sobre as identidades de um dos membros da família. Alguém entra na caravana dos pais de Brenda. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer T6 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Será que a compaixão de Brenda por um viciado em crack improvável irá toldar o seu discernimento numa investigação de homicídio? Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Beyond Paradise T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando um corpo é encontrado no rio na fronteira do condado, Humphrey e Esther são postos frente a frente com os seus homólogos da Cornualha. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Intenções Criminosas T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: O corpo de Emily Trudeau, uma oficial de justiça, é encontrado na casa do seu amante casado, o juiz Peter Blakemore, um candidato a um lugar aberto no tribunal dos apelos. Goren e Eames descobrem que, apesar de ser muito respeitado pela comunidade legal como um especialista na área da lei de propriedade intelectual, os artigos de crítica de lei atribuídos a Blakemore eram na realidade escritos por Trudeau. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Intenções Criminosas T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Os Detectives Goren e Eames investigam o assassinato de um ladrão de bancos em liberdade condicional, morto apenas dois dias depois de ser libertado da prisão de Sing Sing. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: A Marca Rubra
programme.desc: Um pistoleiro participa num esquema para roubar meio milhão de dólares de uma família abastada ligada à criação de gado fingindo ser o filho que foi raptado em criança. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Todos Contra Um
programme.desc: Texas. Quando Meredith, Mary e o filho de 10 anos param num hotel em Laredo, começam a chegar apostadores de todo o lado, incluindo o milionário rígido Henry Drummond, para um jogo de póquer anual - o maior da região! Meredith, como jogador compulsivo que é, implora para ficar a ver. Rapidamente está a jogar também e a perder o dinheiro da família. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Último Comboio de Gun Hill
programme.desc: Um militar tenta levar à justiça o filho de um velho amigo, um dono de gado aristocrata, pelo seu papel na violação e assassinato da sua mulher. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Os Bons e os Maus
programme.desc: Um xerife e um fora-da-lei que já não vão para novos unem forças quando as suas respetivas posições na sociedade são usurpadas por um marechal mais novo, mas incompetente, e o líder de um gangue também mais jovem, mas cruel. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: A Volta de Jesse James
programme.desc: No Missouri da década de 1870, os foras-da-lei Frank (John Pearce) e Jesse James (Robert Duvall, vencedor de um Oscar®) acreditam que receberão amnistia por todos os crimes que cometeram ao longo dos anos. Contudo, aqueles que foram afetados pelos seus crimes não querem ver estes dois irmãos saírem impunes. Um grupo de proprietários de caminhos de ferro contrata os Pinkertons para matar os bandidos. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: As Brancas Montanhas da Morte
programme.desc: Robert Redford, premiado pela academia, é um homem das montanhas do oeste que deseja viver em paz com a natureza. Porém, vê-se apanhado entre os índios e os homens brancos que pretendem apoderar-se das suas terras. Querendo manter-se à parte das duas civilizações, ele torna-se numa lenda temida e respeitada pela vingança que leva a cabo após o massacre da sua família. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Piratas de Monterey
programme.desc: A caminho da Califórnia espanhola para casar com um oficial, uma mulher apaixona-se por um aventureiro americano envolvido em movimentos para derrubar o domínio espanhol. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Assalto ao Carro Blindado
programme.desc: Um 'western' com John Wayne no papel de vilão, adaptado de um romance de Clair Huffaker (Badman), também responsável pelo argumento. A história envolve a vingança de um homem, saído da prisão, e um roubo. 'When the war wagon rolls... the screen explodes! / Quando a caravana de guerra rola... o ecrã explode!', publicitava o cartaz de época. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Os Quatro Filhos de Katie Elder
programme.desc: Quatro irmãos que se juntam num funeral decidem descobrir o assassino do pai, mas em pouco tempo passam de justiceiros a perseguidos pela justiça, com guerras de clãs pelo meio e tiroteios épicos. Western psicológico mas clássico de Henry Hathaway. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: A Marca Rubra
programme.desc: Um pistoleiro participa num esquema para roubar meio milhão de dólares de uma família abastada ligada à criação de gado fingindo ser o filho que foi raptado em criança. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Revólver Mais Trémulo do Oeste
programme.desc: Um assaltante de diligências indultado torna-se agente do governo e casa com uma dentista ingénua do da zona este para se juntar a um comboio e apanhar contrabandistas que vendem armas aos índios. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Um Clube Só Para Cavalheiros
programme.desc: Na segunda-feira, um cowboy do Texas herda o Cheyenne Social Club... Na terça-feira, conhece a rapariga que lá vive... Na quarta-feira, descobre que não se trata de uma estalagem... Quinta-feira, sexta-feira e sábado são dedicados a brigas, confrontos e tiroteios. Ao sétimo dia, descansou. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Duelo
programme.desc: Dois amigos de infância vêem-se em lados opostos da lei. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: A Velha Raposa
programme.desc: John Wayne interpreta a Velha Raposa neste 'western' clássico que finalmente lhe valeu o Óscar de melhor actor (1970). O filme é uma adaptação do 'bestseller' de Charles Portis, filmada por Henry Hathaway, sobre um velho xerife e uma adolescente que o contrata para encontrar o assassino do pai. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: À Mão Armada
programme.desc: Glenn Ford é um ex-pistoleiro e recluso que tenta encontrar uma nova vida no oeste como homem honrado. Porém, com a tentação e a violência à espreita a cada esquina, conseguirá este ex-pecador encontrar o caminho para o céu com uma arma na mão? Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Louis 'Satchmo' Armstrong and His All Stars
programme.desc: Louis Armstrong: Live in '59 is one of the only known complete Armstrong concerts from the 1950s to be captured on film. This 55-minute set, filmed in Belgium in 1959, features many of Satchmo’s greatest songs including ‘Mack The Knife’, ‘When It’s Sleepy Time Down South’ and ‘Stompin’ At The Savoy,’ backed by his stellar band the All-Stars, featuring Trummy Young, Peanuts Hucko, Billy Kyle, Danny Barcelona and Mort Herbert.

programme.title: Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Let's Groove
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Clear Ways
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ray Charles live at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.desc: Filmed at the Madison Square Garden in New York, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Linkin Park performs hits including 'Numb', 'In The End', 'Bleed it Out' and many more.

programme.title: David Guetta - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic David Guetta featuring unforgettable version of his hits: 'Without You', 'Titanium', 'One Love' and many more….

programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Rio', 'Hungry Like The Wolf', 'The Reflex' and many more….

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from Garden Grove, California, formed in 1984. programme.title: Avril Lavigne - Live in Calgary
programme.desc: The Canadian Avril Lavigne enchanted the public in 2007 at her show in Calgary (Canada), in which she released the album “The Best Damn Thing”, which sold, that same year, more than 6 million copies worldwide. The pop singer rocked the audience to the sound of “Girlfriend” as well as other great hits like “Complicated” and “I'm With You”.

programme.title: Queens of the Stone Age - Zénith Paris 2013
programme.desc: Get your fill of riff-oriented heavy rock with this dark and moody performance by Queens of the Stone Age. Best enjoyed with the volume turned up high!.

programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's.

programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass', 'Euphoria', ''Mile High' and many more….

programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won’t be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band’s raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 54
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.
